# Fixtures

`complete/` and `broken/` are checked in; `hostile/` is generated by
`make_fixtures.py` (symlinks and permissions do not survive a checkout well).

The directory names are English, like everything else in this repository. The
names of the components INSIDE a fixture are deliberately German: they stand
in for a foreign plugin whose content the report quotes verbatim, and testing
the escaping and the German report against realistic foreign data is the point
of having fixtures at all.
